# Paying a lot into a pension? Check your annual allowance and any tax charge.

> Free UK pension annual allowance calculator: your tapered allowance for incomes over £260,000, carry forward from the last three years, how much you can still pay in, and the tax charge on any excess. Runs in your browser.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/uk-pension-annual-allowance-calculator/)
